environment.captured: when this report is written; see environment() for what that licenses
environment.data_cached: cold: the corpus is far larger than RAM, so every pass reads from disk rather than page cache
environment.worker_policy: at most 12 worker processes for corpus passes and at most 4 on zkSync, whose row groups are large enough that more workers exhaust memory

memory_note: peak resident memory is not recorded per pass and is therefore not claimed. The scan holds one parquet row group per worker at a time, so its footprint is bounded by row-group size times worker count rather than by chain size; that is a property of the design, not a measurement

metadata_rate_spread.note: the sweep is network-bound; the spread measures public endpoints under throttling, not this code, and is reported for that reason

purpose: performance of the passes that produced the published measurements
